16403.overview:
Electrify your mobile device with this futuristic, block-blasting puzzler!

“Vex Blocks” is the easy-to-play, exciting and addictive block game.  Match up blocks by symbol and/or color to draw the longest chain of lightning possible. Draw lightning chains on your screen to surround and neutralize bomb blocks before they explode or to capture power-ups and increase your coin count.  Collect coins to unlock new game modes or to gear up with unique power-ups like the Black Hole, X-Block or Nuke to help you along the way.  Challenge your friends to beat your score and earn more coins, or team up and take on our score trials together!

Game Features:

—————————————————–

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY

* FREEPLAY:  Relax with a screen full of blocks just waiting to be ELECTRIFIED AND EXPLODED!  BOO YAH!

* TIMED:  How long can you keep playing?  Rack up as many points as you can while earning precious seconds with each lightning chain as you race the clock in the timed mode.

* ARCADE:  Use your lightning or power-ups to destroy blocks and reach your level goal, but don’t let the falling blocks fill the screen as the difficulty increases with each level.

* PUZZLE:  80+ puzzles.  Can you clear the blocks in the fewest moves possible?  Challenge each unique puzzle level and clear all blocks without using up all your moves.
—————————————————–

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Connect to Facebook and challenge your Android and iOS friends to earn a higher score, or play cooperatively to beat score trials and earn even more coins.

CONTROL GRAVITY
Rotate your device to alter gravity and change the block configuration, or use gravity to help you surround and capture Mystery Block power-ups or to neutralize Bomb Blocks before they deaden the blocks around them!

CROSS PLATFORM PLAY
Play Vex Blocks on your phone while on-the-go, then connect to Facebook and access your power-up arsenal and view existing friend challenges on your tablet at home and continue the action across devices and operating systems.

EARN UNIQUE POWER-UPS
Capture Mystery blocks in game to add to your power-up arsenal or earn/purchase coins to select each strategic power-up for later use.

30062.overview: Outplay real opponents in this deep, uncompromising real-time MOBA. Fight with lightning-fast controls using powerful heroes. Destroy the enemy Vain crystal and claim glory! Watch the preview video now to see real gameplay of 3-vs-3 multiplayer battles.

35251.overview:
Vector is an exciting, arcade-style game featuring you as the exceptional free runner who won’t be held down by the system. The game opens with a view into a totalitarian world where freedom and individually is nothing more than a distant dream. But the heart of a freerunner is strong, and you soon break free. Run, vault, slide and climb using extraordinary techniques based on the urban ninja sport of Parkour all while being chased by “Big Brother” who’s sole purpose is to capture you and bring you back.

Inspired by the practice and principles of Parkour, Vector’s intuitive controls please players of all levels, and sophisticated level designs challenge the most demanding players with fast-paced timing puzzles as the traceur “flows” over the dystopian rooftops.

Game Features:

- Arcade gameplay from the makers of the hit Facebook game
- Astoundingly lifelike Parkour-inspired moves made possible by Cascadeur animation tools
- 20 challenging levels (40 in the "Deluxe Version")
- Quick to learn, challenging to master

The best parkour-inspired action game! Vector lets you break free and run! Don’t get caught!

The Press Loves Vector:

“The way Vector mimics the movements of real-life parkour practitioners is quite impressive... I can’t wait to be entrapped in Vector’s promising mix of direction and magnitude.” (appadvice.com)

“Vector is thrilling, rich in variety and it reminds us of Stick Run, but offers much more elaborate animations.” (fbgamer.de)

"The only cool way to run from all your problems." (Gamezebo.com)

“The game looks smashing … ” (idroidplay.com)

166799.overview:
Valkyrie Anatomia: The Origin is a role-playing video game developed and published by Square Enix for iOS and Android devices. The game is a prequel to the original Valkyrie Profile story, and was released in Japan in April 2016.

◇Story◇
The story begins in death... 

The main character, Battlemaiden Lenneth Valkyrie, is preparing for the final war of the gods, Ragnarok. As ordered by Odin, the lord of the gods, Lenneth chooses the souls of heroes to become Einherjar. In their final moments, right before death fully engulfs their souls, they are brought to Valhalla and made to fight in the war of gods.

In this tragedy of men and gods, the Valkyrie grows evermore fond of mortals, and their way of life... 

Will you be able to choose the right future?

◇Newly published RPG by SQUARE ENIX◇

"Battlemaiden Valkyrie, the origin story"

A fantasy RPG inspired by Norse-mythology where the entwined fate of gods and mankind is told using innovative scenario-based game design.

The battle system remains faithful to the familiar style loved by fans of the series and feels intuitive.

◇3 Things About the Game◇
1. Immerse yourself in the world of Norse-mythology - Get excited for creative and original scenarios!
2. Get big critical hits in using a unique combo-driven battle style!
3. The best BGM the industry has to offer breathes life into the game!

The scenarios, battle, and BGM combine to forge a superlative immersive experience.

◇Characters◇
Odin, Lenneth, Frey, Silmeria, Arngrim rejoins the battle!
Familiar characters from ”Valkyrie Profile”,
crossovers and completely new characters join the fray!

Recurring characters have received a new and fresh design!

166800.overview:
For countless years the villagers of Vamp’Ire have enjoyed a life of peace and happiness. But now, rumors are spreading about a wielder of dark magic - a Witchmaster. Fearing the rumors to be true, the village musters a militia to prepare for the worst. You are a recruit enrolling to defend the village. Little do you know, fate has something special in store for you…

Vampire’s Fall: Origins is a 2D open-world RPG with turn-based combat. Create your character, choose your bloodline and venture out in the world. Will you wreck havoc in the land, or be the hero people are longing for? Will you use your powers to battle other players or to hunt ferocious monsters?

• Open world
• Fully customizable characters
• Turn-based combat
• Immersive stories
• Dialogue choices
• PvP battles
• In-game chat
• Skills and abilities to shape your character
• Choose your bloodline: Nosferatu, Ranjeni, Magistrav or Equides
• Over 150 graphically unique weapons and armor

214193.overview:
Vertigo Racing is a mobile game designed and developed by Deep Byte Studios and previously published by Chillingo (Electronic Arts) for iOS/Android. The game had over 4.5 million downloads with over 4-star user rating.

It is a game about driving as fast as you can on suspended roads. The cars steer automatically and you control them just with acceleration and brake. Go as far as you can and don't fall from the suspended road or hit the environment. You can upgrade and drive vintage cars on a variation of suspended tracks. The game's theme blends 1950s Americana visuals with a rockabilly and surf-rock soundtrack.

419651.overview:
Set in a fictional town named Lan Kong Town, which is modelled after Yilan in Taiwan, the story is centred around six high school students who form a band that eventually achieves international fame.

Gameplay is simple, requiring players to touch vertically falling notes that have hit a bar on the bottom of the screen.

Depending on the song, the number of lanes for the notes increases and they shift side to side, making the screen look as if it is dancing to the music.

There are over 100 songs in the library. Three difficulty levels Easy, Hard and Special are available. Players are able to choose difficulty levels according to their skill so they may enjoy all pieces.

475376.overview:
Games have evolved! Merge awesome video games to make the ultimate console!
Time to take the evolution of video games into your own hands!

Combine the universe’s most unique video game consoles into crazy and complex fun machines to usher in a new generation of gaming all by yourself!

Do your part for the evolution of video games and mix the best parts of many kinds of gaming devices until you have the meanest, most powerful super-console of all time!

Heed the call of your gamer destiny and do your duty in the name of video game evolution!

GAMEY FEATURES

🎮Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the video game consoles!

HOW TO PLAY

🎮Use game console eggs to earn coins, buy new devices and make even more money

HIGHLIGHTS

🎮Doodle-like illustrations

A game about making game machines that play games for whoever loves games.

What comes after AAA, again?
